notes: pull-up is on the PCA9685 breakout (10k to its VCC = 3V3); 400 kHz
high = every servo output off (estop, boot). Optional: the breakout pulls OE low by itself
open = engaged = every servo off. No button fitted: put a jumper wire from this pin to GND
the breakout's I2C pull-ups go to VCC: keep VCC at 3V3
do NOT feed the servo supply into this pin: the board runs from USB
firmware default kind=pos; tool rail, on the head
